label: Scene 01
title: Topographic Reveal
intro: A calm aerial opening over the Stanley Peninsula.
description: The journey begins high above coastline, mountains and sea, establishing St. Stephen's College as a rare campus of extraordinary scale.
detailBullets: Golden hour haze across South China Sea
No interface, only guided camera language
Campus enters frame gradually, never abruptly

label: Scene 02
title: Campus Boundary Reveal
intro: A glowing contour traces forty acres of living campus.
description: The complete boundary is drawn with a soft cinematic glow, communicating scale before introducing individual architecture.
detailBullets: Boundary remains as faint contextual guide

label: Scene 03
title: Main Entrance
intro: A descending reveal introduces arrival and identity.
description: The camera settles toward the entrance axis, framing trees, stonework and movement pathways as the opening chapter on campus life.

label: Scene 04
title: School House
intro: A respectful orbit around heritage architecture.
description: A wide circular move presents the School House as a cornerstone of tradition and continuity across generations.
detailBullets: Hero framing of masonry and arches

label: Scene 05
title: The Chapel
description: The camera pauses to let proportion, light and craftsmanship speak with quiet confidence.

label: Scene 06
title: Academic Core
intro: Connected courtyards and classrooms in motion.
description: A sweeping transition glides through the main academic precinct, emphasizing connectivity and openness.
detailBullets: Layered depth from courtyards and canopies

label: Scene 07
title: Library
intro: A gentle circular movement around knowledge and focus.
description: The library is introduced with controlled curvature and calm pace, balancing monumentality with intimacy.

label: Scene 08
title: Science Facilities
intro: A vertical rise highlights innovation infrastructure.
description: The camera ascends from laboratory level to rooftop profile, revealing the science precinct as a center of exploration.
detailBullets: Vertical lift from street to skyline
Clear visual distinction from heritage zones

label: Scene 09
title: Benevolence & Student Life
description: A lower-altitude pass reveals social courtyards, gathering spaces and daily life framed by trees and gardens.
detailBullets: Balanced rhythm between built and natural

label: Scene 10
title: Sports Complex
intro: A faster sweep introduces momentum and performance.
description: The camera accelerates across fields and courts, then eases into a stadium-scale perspective.
detailBullets: Fast lateral pass with controlled banking

label: Scene 11
title: Boarding Facilities
description: A measured pass through boarding terraces highlights continuity, care and the lived rhythm of campus community.

label: Scene 12
title: Sunset Campus Overview
intro: A breathtaking final aerial over the full estate.
description: The film closes with an elevated sunset panorama of the complete campus before the crest and call to action appear.
detailBullets: Final emphasis on heritage and scale
Minimal UI to preserve emotional finish
